Counsel for Applicant :- Ambrish Kumar Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
This is second bail application.

First bail application of the applicant was rejected vide order dated
20.04.2022 passed in criminal misc. bail application No. 14270/2021.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga for the State and perused the record.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that five prosecution witnesses of fact have been examined.
There is no chance of tampering evidence.
The applicant has been in jail for more than four years.
It is further submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 22.01.2020 without having any criminal antecedent.
There is no possibility of the applicant of fleeing away after being released from jail or tampering with the witnesses.
In case the applicant is enlarged on bail, he shall not misuse the Anil vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil ...

sentences.text:
on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68890987/
1 liberty of bail.
AGA has opposed the bail application submitting that perusal of the statement of the victim before the trial court shows that she has supported the prosecution case.
There is corroborative medical evidence.
The victim is seven years old.
It is a heinous offence.

Having considered the argument of the parties and considering the material on record, so also the statements of the victim as well as the medical examination report of the victim who was seven years old at the time of incident, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application of the applicant Anil involved in Case Crime/FIR No. 23/2020,
under Sections 376 A B IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station - Kotwali Dehat, District - Hardoi, is hereby rejected.

Let a copy of this order be transmitted to the trial court for disposal of the trial preferably within a period of six months.
Order Date :- 15.2.2024 R.C.
